machine.name: High-Precision Epoxy & Eutectic Die Bonder
machine.disclaimer:
SYNTHETIC PROTOTYPE TECHNICAL MANUAL

This document is artificially generated for the VectorAI demonstration and software development.

The specifications, thresholds, service-life values, maintenance intervals, and operating parameters are synthetic and must not be used for real industrial equipment operation or maintenance.
machine.description: Dual-head high-precision die attach system designed for bonding semiconductor micro-dies onto copper leadframes, organic substrates, and BGA interposers with sub-micron placement accuracy.
machine.manufacturingProcess: A wafer ring expander presents singulated dies. An ejector needle pushes the target die upward, where a vacuum pickup collet retrieves it, performs in-flight vision alignment, and places it onto epoxy-dispensed substrate pads under controlled force and thermal conditions.
subsystems: Pneumatic Jet Valve Epoxy Dispensing System
Wafer Table Ring Expander & Multi-Needle Ejector

components.name: Vacuum Pick-up Collet
components.function: Grips die surface securely without inducing mechanical stress.
components.importantParameters: Vacuum pressure (-kPa), collet tip wear (µm), contact angle.
components.degradationIndicators: Vacuum pressure drop (>-60 kPa), die pickup tilt.

components.name: Wafer Ejector Needle Mechanism
components.function: Pushes die upward from dicing tape carrier.
components.importantParameters: Needle tip radius (µm), stroke height (mm), sync timing (ms).
components.degradationIndicators: Needle tip bluntness, tape puncture, die cracking.

components.name: Epoxy Jet Dispense Valve
components.importantParameters: Dispense pressure (bar), nozzle temp (°C), dot volume (nL).

components.name: Heated Workholder Platen
components.function: Heats substrate to promote epoxy wetting and curing.
components.degradationIndicators: Thermal gradient (>3°C across strip), heater burnout.

sensors.name: Bond Arm Vibration
sensors.purpose: Monitors placement arm mechanical jitter and bearing smoothness.

sensors.name: Collet Vacuum Pressure
sensors.purpose: Measures negative suction pressure holding die on collet tip.

warning.description: Arm bearing wear or linear motor jitter

critical.description: Severe placement tilt & die cracking risk

warning.description: Collet seal leakage or filter loading

operatingConditions.recommendedOperatingConditions: Collet vacuum > -80 kPa, epoxy pot life < 8 hours

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Collet tip replacement and optical touch-off
maintenance.procedureSummary: Swap silicone collet, clean vacuum channel, perform PR fiducial camera offset teaching.

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Needle tip height calibration and microscopic wear check
maintenance.procedureSummary: Measure needle tip protrusion under vision scope, adjust Z-height offset to 0.15mm.

degradationIndicators.physicalPhenomenon: Solenoid valve particulate loading & rubber tip wear
degradationIndicators.measurableEffect: Vacuum decays from -84 kPa to -54 kPa
degradationIndicators.degradationSignificance: Causes die pickup skew and bond-line thickness (BLT) variance

symptoms.recommendedAction: Flush vacuum filter, replace pick collet, and verify epoxy dispense weight.

failureScenarios.symptom: Collet Vacuum Seal Leakage & Ejector Pin Timing Drift
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Flush vacuum solenoid filter, replace silicone collet, and re-teach ejector needle Z-height.
verificationSteps: Run 20-die dummy placement and measure BLT with laser profiler (< 2µm variance)
